evaluationScope: Nine upstream repository example/training photographs and their supplied masks. Parameters were explored on these same examples, so this is an engineering comparison, not an independent accuracy estimate or production guarantee.

preprocessing.experimentImplementation: Python PIL Image.Resampling.BOX, whole RGB frame stretched to 128x128; normalization channel/127.5-1; float32 NCHW
preprocessing.appImplementation: Dart package:image Interpolation.average, after EXIF correction and working-image longest-edge cap of 1600
preprocessing.relationship: PIL BOX is a practical approximation to Dart area averaging, not a claim of pixel-identical preprocessing. The upstream export parity and earlier reference validation used PIL bilinear, retained separately.
preprocessing.output: Model probabilities already contain sigmoid; no second sigmoid.

runtimeInference.rotationStage: Rotate the prepared 128x128 RGB tensor, not the whole high-resolution image.
runtimeInference.input180IndexMapping: Within each NCHW color plane, rotated[i] = original[16383-i].
runtimeInference.fusion: Set rejected components to zero in each view, inverse-transform the rotated output, then take the maximum retained probability per pixel.
runtimeInference.finalFilter: Apply the same component filtering to the fused map.

postprocessingChanges.handLandmarks: Used only for best-effort finger labels and direction; unmatched or duplicate associations do not discard model candidates.
postprocessingChanges.limitation: No missing nail is synthesized from a hand template. Manual add/correction remains necessary.

recommendedMeasurements.note: Upstream images, not independent validation. Mask coverage is 20% GT instance pixels; not commercial accuracy.
recommendedMeasurements.method: 0+180 full-frame; per-view threshold .38, component mean .57, min3, max8%; inverse-transform then max accepted probability, same postfilter

metrics.dice: Pixel Dice against supplied GT resized to 128x128 with nearest sampling.
metrics.objectRecall: Fraction of GT connected-component nails with at least 20% of their GT pixels covered. This is a coverage heuristic, not IoU-based detection AP.
metrics.falseComponents: Predicted connected components with fewer than 20% of their own pixels intersecting any GT nail.
metrics.components: Metrics cover semantic masks before the optional per-photo maximum of 12 displayed regions; hand association is not measured here.

rotationExploration.conclusion: Two opposite full-frame views were selected over default four-way union because four-way relaxed union increased false components. Four-way inference is not the default runtime.

rejectedTilingExploration.conclusion: Overlapping 2x2 crops changed the model input distribution. They added background components; an 80%-crop union produced false foreground on a uniform gray image. Tiling is not enabled in the runtime.

limitations: Short, bare, side-facing, occluded or tiny nails still get missed. This update does not make segmentation complete.
Plain black/white/gray and seeded noise inputs are a small sanity check, not a comprehensive negative set.
The measured gain cannot be reported as accuracy on real users or as a calibrated confidence score.
Tensor dimensions and model weights are unchanged.
